what: DeepSWE repos with >= 2 tasks and whether their tasks can be chained in one container (chained-pilot step 1)
notes: Held-out tasks (S0's draw for S5) are listed but never chained.
peaks: DeepSWE's uncompacted mini-swe-agent peaks (4 rollouts per config); Haiku 5.5 has none.
reference_solution_overlap: files both reference patches touch, a proxy for conflicting edits; the agents' own edits may differ.

chain_groups: tasks sharing a base commit (held-out removed); dockerfiles_same_ignoring_comments compares the files without comments, blank lines and wrapping. Each task is still graded in its own verifier image.
same_image_layers compares images.json layer digests; a distinct tag per task with identical Dockerfiles may still differ in the last layers.
